nuggets.text: Hall of Famers Michael Strahan and Winston Hill both played college football for the Tigers.
The Tigers' Ocean of Soul band performed with Beyoncé at the NFL's Christmas Day halftime show in 2024.
The Ocean of Soul marching band performed at halftime of Super Bowl XXXVIII in 2004.
Michael Strahan donated $100,000 to the Ocean of Soul band at his 2014 Hall of Fame induction.
Head coach Cris Dishman played 13 NFL seasons, the first nine with the Houston Oilers, and made two Pro Bowls.
The Tigers rallied from 14-0 down to beat N.C. Central 42-30 in their opener.
Jordan Thompson took a blocked punt 34 yards for a touchdown, giving the Tigers their first lead against N.C. Central.
Cam'Ron McCoy threw 3 touchdown passes on just 8 completions against N.C. Central.
Three Tigers, Nico Guerra, Xavier Phipps and Machi Robinson, used to play for UTEP.
Athean Renfro Jr. ran for 163 yards on only 18 carries in the Tigers' opener.
